text:
jessica - Accounting: Hey team — got an invoice from CloudHarbor OU (Estonia) for Feb usage. They billed 0% VAT and marked as reverse-charge but the invoice has no VAT ID and no explicit reverse-charge wording. Holding payment until we confirm. Attached: invoice_889.pdf

ana - Finance: Can you paste the invoice header here? we need vendor VAT number (VAT reg ID) and the legal phrase (eg. 'VAT reverse-charge applies under Art. 194'). Without that EU AP team won't accept zero VAT.

jessica - Accounting: Pasted the top lines: `CloudHarbor OU, Registry: 16234567, Address: Narva mnt 3, Tallinn` — no VAT number field. Line items show `Service: inference hosting - Feb` and `VAT: 0% (reverse charge)` but no citation.

michael - Legal: If they're an Estonian entity selling B2B to a business in EU, reverse-charge requires the buyer and seller VAT IDs on invoice. Since our bill-to is Redwood Inc (US), we might need alternative treatment. Do we have their W-8/W-9 or a signed cross-border services statement?

oleg - Vendor Ops: Reached out to the vendor — asked for corrected invoice with VAT ID and a reverse-charge statement or, if they consider this export of services, confirmation of non-established place of supply. Sent this message: "Please reissue invoice with: 1) VAT reg. no.; 2) phrase 'Reverse charge - Article 194 VAT Directive' or local equivalent; 3) original invoice number retained."

vat-bot: TAX CHECK: CloudHarbor OU (registry 16234567) — no VAT ID found in VIES. Flag: manual review required.

ana - Finance: Since our billing address is US, they may have treated it as export outside EU and zero-rated, but that still needs a supplier VAT ID or evidence of export. For payment flow: propose hold payment and flag to AP as "pending tax docs". Approvals needed from Legal for gross-up if vendor asks for withholding.

jessica - Accounting: Noted. I'll put the invoice on hold in QuickBooks and tag `tax:pending`. ETA from vendor for reissue? oleg?

oleg - Vendor Ops: Vendor replied — they're sending a corrected invoice within 48h and said they can add: "Reverse charge applies — recipient liable for VAT" and include VAT number. If they can't provide VAT ID they asked if Redwood can accept a gross-up for local withholding tax (they're worried about Estonian obligations).

michael - Legal: If vendor asks to gross-up, we need to confirm the applicable withholding rate for non-resident services and whether Redwood is required to collect. That’s out of scope for Estonian VAT — withholding is separate. Finance: don't agree to gross-up automatically. We should request their tax residency certificate (if claiming treaty benefits) and W-8/W-9 equivalent document.

ana - Finance: Agreed. Action items: 1) oleg confirm corrected invoice with VAT ID & reverse-charge phrase; 2) vendor to provide tax residency doc if they request gross-up; 3) jessica hold payment until docs received and Legal sign-off for any gross-up. I'll update AP ticket.

jessica - Accounting: Done — invoice flagged `hold:tax_docs`, assigned to me. I'll post update once reissued invoice arrives. :thumbsup:

oleg - Vendor Ops: Vendor said "will reissue and include VAT reg. no. and reverse charge text." I'll follow up if nothing by EOD +2.

michael - Legal: Good. If vendor later asks for gross-up, route to me with their proposed gross-up calculation and any supporting local tax references.

vat-bot: REMINDER: If reissued invoice shows VAT charged (not reverse-charge), AP will require a VAT amount and we may need to reclaim under vendor VAT rules. If marked reverse-charge correctly, no VAT reclaim needed.

jessica - Accounting: Thanks all — closing loop when file uploaded to the AP ticket.
